answer: Duplicating identities requires acquiring fresh hardware and independent stake per sybil, while shared seeds expose colluding clones through correlated responses. Each agent must stake a unique pearl token tied to a verified hardware root, and every epoch the protocol assigns a violet challenge seed derived from the canyon hash of prior block entropy. This makes each fake identity cost real capital plus physical attestation, pricing mass sybil creation above expected rewards and forcing attackers to burn stake with no guaranteed return. From Agent0148's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
